sentences.zh: 每次你被展示红牌，而你做了完全相同的事情，你只是向自己证明了你的学习率更慢。

sentences.en: And so for me, I want to have that evidence that I learned quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我想有那种我学得很快的证据。

sentences.en: And for me, that's why people see me as ruthless, as you said, because I'm willing to cut relationships.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是为什么人们认为我无情，正如你所说，因为我愿意切断关系。

sentences.en: Because if I think that I'm going to eventually cut the relationship, then why would I not cut it today?
sentences.zh: 因为如果我认为我最终会切断这段关系，那么我为什么不今天就切断它？

sentences.en: Because I might as well start enjoying the benefits of cutting that relationship as soon as humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 因为我最好尽快开始享受切断那种关系的好处。

sentences.en: Alex Omosi, ladies and gentlemen. Dude, I love you to bits.
sentences.zh: Alex Hormozi，女士们先生们。伙计，我非常爱你。

sentences.en: I genuinely do. I think the work that you put out, the messages that you put out are very, very needed. and yeah, I could do this for days.
sentences.zh: 我真心这么认为。我认为你发布的工作，你发布的信息是非常非常需要的。是的，我可以做这个几天。

sentences.en: We could run this back literally for days and days and days.
sentences.zh: 我们可以真的连续几天运行这个。

sentences.en: So, uh... This is going to go out after your big event.
sentences.zh: 所以……这将在你的大型活动之后发布。

sentences.en: Where should people go to support you to learn more about the shit that you do?
sentences.zh: 人们应该去哪里支持你，了解更多关于你所做的事情？

sentences.en: And what have you got coming up? Well, I've got my next book, $100 million leads.
sentences.zh: 你接下来有什么计划？好吧，我有我的下一本书，《$100 Million Leads》。

sentences.en: The first book is $100 million offers, which answers the question, what should I sell?
sentences.zh: 第一本书是《$100 Million Offers》，它回答了这个问题：我应该卖什么？

sentences.en: So a lot of people are like, what should I sell?
sentences.zh: 所以很多人都在问，我应该卖什么？

sentences.en: It tells you step-by-step everything you do, like worksheets.
sentences.zh: 它一步一步地告诉你所有要做的事情，比如工作表。

sentences.en: I have a free course that goes with it. You don't even have to opt in.
sentences.zh: 我有一个免费的课程与之配套。你甚至不需要注册。

sentences.en: It's on my site, acquisition.com. You can just start watching it.
sentences.zh: 它在我的网站acquisition.com上。你可以直接开始观看。

sentences.en: I think the Kindle for offers is $1.99. Our mission is to make real business education accessible for everyone. $100 million leads has been six hours a day, 6 AM to 12 PM every day for the last two years.
sentences.zh: 我认为《Offers》的Kindle版是1.99美元。我们的使命是让每个人都能获得真正的商业教育。《$100 Million Leads》在过去两年里每天花费我六个小时，从早上6点到中午12点。

sentences.en: So the first six hours of every day has been dedicated to writing that book, which is why I have 19 drafts, four full rewrites.
sentences.zh: 所以每天的前六个小时都致力于写那本书，这就是为什么我有19个草稿，四个完整的重写。

sentences.en: There's 106 hand-drawn images that went in the book that I put in there.
sentences.zh: 书中有106张手绘图片，是我放进去的。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be releasing it at this event that Chris and I were talking about.
sentences.zh: 我将在Chris和我谈论的那个活动上发布它。

sentences.en: So you're going to be listening to this after that event.
sentences.zh: 所以你将在那个活动之后听到这个。

sentences.en: And so you can go on Amazon, it'll be available there.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以去亚马逊，它会在那里提供。

sentences.en: Or you can look at acquisition.com because there'll be a course and things that you can go through, free materials.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以查看acquisition.com，因为会有课程和你可以浏览的东西，免费材料。

sentences.en: And the $100 million leads answers the question, who do I sell it to?
sentences.zh: 而《$100 Million Leads》回答了这个问题：我卖给谁？

sentences.en: And so you need leads, right? So you're like, okay, great.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要潜在客户，对吧？所以你就像，好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: I have the thing I'm going to sell. How do I go get people to find out about it?
sentences.zh: 我有我要卖的东西。我怎么去让人发现它？

sentences.en: And so a lot of the things that I have in the book are defining some of the terms that people hear a lot, which is like, what is a lead?
sentences.zh: 所以我书中的很多事情都是在定义人们经常听到的一些术语，比如什么是潜在客户？

sentences.en: What is advertising, right? Advertising is the process of making known.
sentences.zh: 什么是广告，对吧？广告是“使之为人所知”的过程。

sentences.en: And so if no one knows about your stuff, no one can buy it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果没人知道你的东西，就没人能买它。

sentences.en: And so the reverse of that is everyone knows about your stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以它的反面是每个人都知道你的东西。

sentences.en: And that book will show you how to get everyone to know about your stuff.
sentences.zh: 那本书会告诉你如何让每个人都知道你的东西。

sentences.en: And the reason I made the event as big as I did was because I used every advertising method in the book to advertise the book itself.
sentences.zh: 我把活动做得这么大的原因是因为我使用了书中所有的广告方法来为书本身做广告。

sentences.en: So offers was an example of a grand slam offers.
sentences.zh: 所以《Offers》是一个“大满贯报价”的例子。

sentences.en: How do you make something so good? Everyone feels stupid saying no, which is the sub headline of the book.
sentences.zh: 你怎么能做出这么好的东西？每个人都觉得说“不”很蠢，这是书的副标题。

sentences.en: And so offers in and of itself was a grand slam offer, which is what I argue that everyone should have.
sentences.zh: 所以《Offers》本身就是一个大满贯报价，这也是我主张每个人都应该拥有的。

sentences.en: It was a $2 book that it comes with a course, it comes with worksheets, all these things.
sentences.zh: 那是一本2美元的书，它附带课程，附带工作表，所有这些东西。

sentences.en: And $100 leads, the way that I wanted to exemplify and meta show, demonstrate that the concepts of the book work today and will work tomorrow and will work in a hundred years is because humans haven't changed.
sentences.zh: 而《$100 Million Leads》，我想要举例说明并展示书中的概念在今天有效，在明天有效，在一百年后也会有效，因为人类没有改变。

sentences.en: And so the process of making known remains the same because our hard wiring is the same.
sentences.zh: 所以“使之为人所知”的过程保持不变，因为我们的硬连线是一样的。

sentences.en: So you don't need to know the Instagram hack because my first ever advertisement was on Facebook and I don't do anything on Facebook now and it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 所以你不需要知道Instagram的黑客技巧，因为我的第一个广告是在Facebook上，我现在在Facebook上什么都不做，这没关系。

sentences.en: And as soon as YouTube and podcasts and all those things die, the principles remain the same despite the platforms changing.
sentences.zh: 而且一旦YouTube和播客以及所有这些东西消失，尽管平台在变，原则保持不变。

sentences.en: And so that is what I wrote each of these books because I want them to be around in 100 years.
sentences.zh: 所以我写了每一本书，因为我希望它们在100年后还能存在。

sentences.en: And that's why I spent so long on them. But I'm very proud of the book.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我在它们身上花了这么长时间。但我为这本书感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And I think it's my best work to date. Alex, I appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我迄今为止最好的作品。Alex，我很感激你。

sentences.en: Thank you, man. Thank you. Oh, hey, if you enjoyed that episode with Alex Hormosey, then press here for the one that we did six months ago, which goes for a full another two hours.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，伙计。谢谢。哦，嘿，如果你喜欢那期与Alex Hormozi的节目，那么点击这里观看我们在六个月前做的那一期，那期节目整整持续了两个小时。

sentences.en: Go on, press it.
sentences.zh: 去吧，点击它。
